comments.author: Real_Feels
comments.body_html:
Hi Salco, after the recent Armory mod update, I was thrilled to see so many new attachments that weren’t there before. But what really made me stop and think was the ‘I’m Okay’ stim.

Lately, I’ve come to realize that all the easy, convenient things in modern life can actually become toxic, and I’ve seen many people fall into nihilism because of it. Honestly, maybe I was one of them too… haha.

Anyway, reading the text on that stim made me use it in-game right away, step out of the virtual world, and face the adventures waiting in real life—finding my true self outside the screen. Things like working out or reaching out to someone I love. I think I had taken those simple, obvious things for granted and forgot how precious they really are.

Sorry for rambling… lol. What I’m saying isn’t empty sympathy for whatever problems you might be facing, nor is it coming from some arrogant place of thinking my situation is any better. I’m just saying this as one human being to another: This too shall pass. Let’s cherish every moment, and let’s all be happy.

comments.author: S4LCO
comments.body_html: Don’t apologize for your “rambling.” It’s great that you took the time to read the text of the Stim, write these lines to me, and even think about it. You’ve impressively proven to me that the Stim works just as I imagined it would, and I thank you for that.

comments.author: Real_Feels
comments.body_html: I’m not sure where we’ll all end up once Forge goes down, but I’ll definitely be looking forward to seeing your work wherever you go. Best of luck with everything!
